mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ref_order(group_id, submitter_id, submitter_name, project_group_name, status, submit_remark, submitted_at) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{submitterId}, #{submitterName}, #{projectGroupName}, #{status}, #{submitRemark}, #{submittedAt})
